headline: Grind City learns to fly: Big Air pays the pump
lede: The flagship program Jon steered this week opens with the missing half of momentum — speed now cashes out. Pump the drop-in, ollie above 1.30 m off the lip, and the amplitude itself banks points; crest the roof deck fast and it's MEGA AIR.

notes.text: GRIND CITY Big Air (#3945, flagship slice 1 of #3941): launch amplitude pays on clean landings — BIG AIR ≥1.30 m (150 + 220/m), MEGA AIR ≥1.90 m, riding the chain multiplier; bails forfeit. Action-cam cut-in and two new voices sell it.

Both attract bots are provably untouched: the witness line still scores exactly 18910 and the searched line exactly 20702 with zero paid airs — the human pump line owns the new payday. grindcheck grows to 30 mutants; the amplitude mutant dies clean.
Main went red overnight (17 mutants refused at once) — one stale Lemmings replay fixture dirtying nightly's tree. Fix shipped mid-shift (#3943); the verification nightly is in flight.
Flagship slice map posted on #3941: revert grammar next, then switch stance, then the Special meter. Each slice is one shippable, playable increment.

look.text: SSX manuals: land a trick, hold the edge, roll into a manual
